title: 16.31. Pītittika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Pītisahagataṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca napītisahagato nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā aṭṭhavīsa …pe… avigate aṭṭhavīsa.
Pītisahagataṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naupekkhāsahagato nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā aṭṭhārasa …pe… avigate aṭṭhārasa.
